title: Preservation Hall

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Preservation Hall offers one of the most intimate and iconic private event experiences in New Orleans. Located in the heart of the French Quarter, the historic Creole mansion has served as the home of traditional New Orleans jazz since 1961, welcoming generations of artists, musicians, and audiences into its legendary performance space. From the moment guests pass through the wrought iron gates, they are immersed in the spirit, history, and unmistakable energy of New Orleans.
